{{Quote|I can break free some resources for a methodical search for traders operating in dead systems, strange comings and goings, and other telltales.''"''<br />''"''Still, that would mean finding a needle in a slightly smaller haystack.|[[Angela Krin]] and [[Mander Zuma]]|<ref name="Scourge (novel)">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
'''Hay''' was dried [[Grass/Legends|grass]]. It was often piled into stacks, manipulated by hooks, and carried in [[cart]]s. A common expression was that searching for something small in a large area was like trying to find a needle in a haystack.
